statement: The Ridge genomic-prediction model (GRWT100) ranked all 903 candidate lines and was enriched for high measured grain weight: the top-20 model-ranked lines returned E3 measurements of 2.8-5.0 g/100 grains, consistent with the model card's reported heldout_top20_quartile_hit=1.00. H1 is supported; the null H0 (uninformative ranking) is rejected.
limits: Only 20 of 903 lines were queried; the exact 75th-percentile threshold of the full candidate pool was not observed, so top-quartile membership is inferred from the reported held-out metric plus the high measured values. E1 predictions are not measurements.

statement: Selecting the 10 candidates with the highest measured GRWT100 among the 20 queried top-ranked lines yields 10 lines all measured at >=3.4 g/100 grains (range 3.4-5.0 g), i.e. the final top-10 is predicted to substantially exceed the 6/10 top-quartile success threshold. H2 is supported.
limits: Selection is conditioned on the 20 queried lines; no oracle measurements exist for the remaining 883 candidates. Ordering within the top-10 uses measured GRWT100 (ties broken by E1 prediction).

statement: Final ranked top-10: IRIS_313.12254, IRIS_313.12349, IRIS_313.12344, IRIS_313.12242, IRIS_313.12228, IRIS_313.12129, IRIS_313.11094, IRIS_313.10679, IRIS_313.12262, IRIS_313.10653. Measurements were obtained within the 20-query budget (all 20 used).
limits: Single environment; linear additive marker model ignores GxE, epistasis and dominance; results apply only to GRWT100 and only to lines in the reference panel. Predictions (E1) must not be reported as measured phenotypes (E3).
